[center]---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/center]
[center][size=5]关于新版本 About KV 2.X.X[/size][/center]
[center][/center]
鉴于多前置的复杂性和需要切换的不便捷性等因素（以及手机兼容的考虑），现在修改了前置，仅需要一个本体和一个前置，无需切换即可实现替换

AI translation：

Due to the complexity of multiple pre-modifiers and the inconvenience of switching between them (as well as considerations for mobile device compatibility), the pre-modifier system has been redesigned. It now requires only one main body and one pre-modifier, allowing for seamless replacement without the need for switching.

MOD link：
[center]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36813[/center]

[center]---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[/center]

你好，我是风吟梧桦(b站)。这是鸡窝谷mod的整合版本。您需要下载的前置为：
[list]
[*][s]Portraiture[/s][/*]
[*][s]Portraiture Plus[/s][/*]
[*][color=#ff0000]Content Patcher[/color][/*]
[*][s]Kivovalley Sound Lib  (下版本中将不再需要)[/s][/*]
[*][color=#ff0000]Scale up unofficial[/color][/*]
[/list]
如果你不会调配置文件，请不要下载：
[list]
[*]Seasonal cute characters[/*]
[/list]这一类的mod，[color=#ff0000]任何修改小人的mod都可能会影响本模组的成功替换！[/color]
mod压缩包会包含两个内容：

KivoValley NPCs Collection
﻿- [CP] KivoValley NPCs Collection
[s]﻿- [PPlus] Kivo Valley HD Portraits[/s]

全新的文件结构可以不用劳烦各位放文件，想必可以解决百分之99%的问题。你所需要做的就是直接进入游戏，进入存档，在与NPC对话时（注意是进行时而不是过去时），按m键，然后选中"[color=#f4cccc]ST.KivoValley.HDPortraits[/color]"这个肖像包，就可以了！

最后就是不要转载，以及期待我的更新！

[color=#00ff00]----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------English Translation---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------[/color]

This is an integrated version of the student mod. what u need to use mod are:
[list]
[*][list]
[*][s]Portraiture[/s][/*]
[*][s]Portraiture Plus[/s][/*]
[*][color=#ff0000]Content Patcher[/color][/*]
[*][s]Kivovalley Sound Lib[/s][/*]

[/list][/*]
[/list]
and this mod contains [color=#ff0000]1 [/color]files:

KivoValley NPCs Collection
﻿- [CP] KivoValley NPCs Collection
[s]﻿- [PPlus] Kivo Valley HD Portraits[/s]

I've optimized the file system and u can skip many steps, just drag these 2 folders to ur "Mods\" and launch the game. Then find someone to talk and press "M" to choose or "P" to switch to the "[color=#f4cccc]ST.KivoValley.HDPortraits[/color]" to enable the HD Portraits!

OK that's all, enjoy ur game!
